HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   C. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

3. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.

   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   B. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   B. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   B. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   C. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
